source_family: SPLADE++ EnsembleDistil neural sparse passage retrieval
selection_rule: Accessible cached artifacts for both years, bounded size, and meaningfully different documented evidence representation; not comparative relevance outcomes.

provenance.production_limit: Producer code identifies the current cache family and retrieval path; exact historical generation commit, index/encoder digests, and full command were not supplied with the cache.

usage_notes.raw_cache_license: No explicit dataset-card license was supplied by the inspected metadata; model licensing is not assumed to license cache passages.
usage_notes.artifact_policy: Use publicly served cache locally for research; keep original query/passage text in ignored local cache. Commit source provenance, acquisition code, numeric ranking facts and observation results only; no model weights or original passage/query text.

considered_families.status: Documented full-index generation; no small precomputed run established through the checked Pyserini route.
Official 2019 raw run HTTP401 without credentials; corresponding 2020 family not established.
Selected before observation analysis; two cached files with published LFS SHA256/size metadata.
